Third pre-release of 2.2 — **conditions** in Bookends lines.

## New

- **Conditions in this line** (tab *Lines*, selected line): Bookends shows part of a line only under a condition, `[if:batt<20]LOW[else]%batt[/if]`. Bookbench lists the conditions of the selected line (nested ones below their outer one) and lets you add, edit and dissolve them in a small window: fields from Bookends' own list (battery, Wi-Fi, odd/even page, book %, time, weekday, series …) or any other field, comparison, value, *and*/*or*, then/otherwise text. Conditions with brackets can be edited as text.
- **Format > Examples with conditions**: Bookends' ready-made lines (Kindle-style time left, battery bars, weekend …).
- **Special characters** is now a drop-down menu like *Insert token*.
- The six position buttons are bigger and grow with the column; *Capitals* and *Show on* have their own rows.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy (with *Settings > Updates > Include pre-releases* on), or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_2.2-beta3.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
